historicalReview.note: An order joins column, capital and entablature in an organized system. Keep the typical temple plan separate from each monument's actual openings and movement.

Correct the implication that one can walk directly from the statue chamber to the rear chamber in the Parthenon. The larger east room and smaller west room had separate entrances without internal communication.

The Propylaia gives a documented threshold and a wider central passage. A viewpoint sequence can teach the effect of an angled approach, with an explicit distinction between interpretation, original diagram and exact surveyed reconstruction.
The Agora was a civic gathering space. The Stoa of Attalos illustrates a sheltered colonnade at the edge of the square. Distinguish ancient use from the later rebuilding.

Use Sanchi's stupa dome and walking route, then the Hindu sanctum and tower, as separate case studies. Describe the cosmic-mountain reading as a documented interpretation of a typology, without claiming identical religious meaning.
Keep the successive palace gates, Suzhou's shaped natural landscape, and Katsura's deliberately screened view separate. Do not generalize any one sequence to all Chinese or Japanese architecture.

visualReference.credit: Gift of The American Society for the Excavation of Sardis, 1926
visualReference.observation: The photographed museum display shows the scrolls of the Ionic capital, surviving shaft portions and base. The display is partial and the surrounding modern gallery columns are not part of the Sardis object. The native original did not download in this pass. Keep the 600×608 copy as a source reference until the original or a deliberate small inset is reviewed.

gameplayCandidate.recordingPlan: Prefer a player-controlled approach from an identified gateway to a legible row of columns and an oblique view of a named building. A second scene is useful only if it shows the same architectural relation on a different building. Keep developer tour videos and their audio out of the cut.
gameplayCandidate.limitation: The publisher's creative-use policy does not cover another recordist's separate rights. No original route or native FHD capture was located in the bounded old-media search. App 812140 was not present in the three configured Steam libraries. Preserve exact before/action/result, recorder permission and actual frame evidence before selection.

authoredComparison.renderer: Unity with matched player and overhead views
authoredComparison.visualDirection: Drive both views from the same continuously changing diameter. Keep height, center spacing, camera, floor and entablature fixed. Attach one spacing marker center-to-center and a second to the actual empty opening. Keep the real architectural orders in separate original explanatory drawings.
